tx:
▸ Divine energy cost
All types of divine energy have a buying limit of 25,000 on the Grand Exchange. The "profit vs empty" is calculated taking into account the value of crafting an empty divine charge and selling it on the Grand Exchange ().
The energy's normal Divination level requirement is not required when making divine charges (e.g. Incandescent energy can be used to make charges without level 95 Divination).
▸ Cost of simple parts
Six suggested items to disassemble for simple parts are maple logs, acadia logs, magic logs, gold bars, maple incense sticks and harralander tar, due to the low cost, reasonable junk chance, and high availability.
Disassembling gold bars gives simple parts about 35% faster than disassembling maple logs, but it costs times as much. Disassembling harralander tar gives simple parts even faster while being times more expensive than disassembling maple logs. For ironmen, maple logs can be more easily obtained in large quantities via Managing Miscellania, whereas the others are more tedious to obtain.
With the release of Menaphos, acadia logs are another option for simple parts. Their extremely low junk chance makes them one of the fastest sources, allowing the player to obtain almost twice as many simple parts per hour at times the price.
For even cheaper simple parts, one can buy flatpacks (disassembly calculator) on the Grand Exchange, as there are many worth under 100 coins, and they share the same disassembly category as bars (thus 75% simple, varying junk; many mahogany and teak items are both very cheap and almost never give junk). The main drawbacks of flatpacks include unreliable supply and low Grand Exchange buy limits (only 100 per 4 hours).

tx:
Tokens could only be earned while a Double XP event was active. They could be earned regardless of whether the player had the timer running.
• Each minute when the player performed a skilling action on a members' world, they had a chance to be rewarded 200 tokens from a "Double XP spirit". This happened automatically, requiring no further interaction from the player.
• Using standard protean items directly gave 4 tokens each. However, using protean processors or unstable protean items did not reward tokens. Using unstable protean items did have the chance to trigger a Double XP spirit despite this.
• Using personal elite training dummies gave 80 tokens each. Using dummy processors and other players' dummies did not yield tokens.
• Up to 10,000 protean items could be converted directly into 20,000 tokens each day at a 1:2 ratio. This could be done by using the default info option on a token and then choosing to exchange proteans. A menu would then ask which type of protean and how many to exchange.
• 2,000 tokens could be received each day by exchanging 1 hour of Double XP time in the DXP Token Store.

tx:
Harmonic dust can be used to make several types of crystal equipment:
• A crystal weapon seed, crystal armour seed, or crystal tool seed can be sung into regular crystal weapons, crystal shields, or crystal tools by singing at a singing bowl.
• An attuned crystal weapon seed can be used to make attuned crystal weapons, and an attuned crystal armour seed can be used to make attuned crystal shields at the singing bowl in Ithell district.
• Three important crystal tools can be obtained by upgrading their dragon counterparts with Lady Ithell, which works even if the dragon items are on the tool belt or they are augmented (but, to upgrade an augmented item, the item must be used on Lady Ithell):
• A crystal hatchet can be obtained by giving her 4,000 harmonic dust and a dragon hatchet. A crystal hatchet is required to create the hatchet of ember and glade.
• A crystal pickaxe can be obtained by giving her 4,000 harmonic dust and a dragon pickaxe or Imcando pickaxe. A crystal pickaxe is required to create the pickaxe of earth and song.
• A crystal mattock can be obtained by giving her 4,000 harmonic dust and a dragon mattock. A crystal mattock is required to create the mattock of time and space.
• An attuned crystal teleport seed, which provides unlimited teleports and can be equipped in the pocket slot, can be obtained by singing with 4,000 harmonic dust and a crystal teleport seed at the singing bowl in Ithell district.
• 5,000 harmonic dust is one of the ingredients of the blessed flask shell, a required component of the blessed flask.
• 150 harmonic dust is one of the ingredients of the Crystal binding rod.

Playing the harps in the Ithell district grants a chance of receiving 1 dust and 80 Crafting experience (96 experience when the Voice of Seren is on the Ithell district) every three seconds. The rate is reduced as the harp goes out of tune, and higher levels also grant higher rates. While the Voice is active, harps also go out of tune at a much lower rate, meaning a greater rate of dust. At level 99 Crafting, a player can get about 1,080 harmonic dust an hour with optimal retuning (which equals 86,400 experience an hour), or 1120 dust during Voice of Seren (107,520 experience per hour). The exact success chance can be found on the harp page.
With the 2026 early-game rebalance, Ithell workers may be thieved continuously as long as the player keeps up their Crystal Mask. With continual refreshes, this results in around 350 harmonic dust per hour, alongside other loot gained such as crafting and construction materials and crystal seeds. 
The Artificer's measure provides a constant Ithell Voice of Seren buff effect, regardless of the current Voice of Seren. This does not stack with the actual Ithell Voice of Seren when it is active.
A one time reward of 1,000 harmonic dust is given after completing the elite Tirannwn achievements from Elen Anterth. However, at least 1,000 harmonic dust is required to sing an attuned crystal weapon for one of the achievements.
It's also possible to receive harmonic dust as a reward from Meg in the player-owned port.
